detailed_descriptions.en: Belts of Iron is an open world, third-person, factory building game. As a solo developer your support and feedback is crucial to the continued development of the game. Explore vast procedurally generated worlds where every playthrough offers something new. Venture off in search of rich resource deposits, uncover unique landscapes, and share your favorite world seeds with friends. But beware, exploration comes at a cost, native hostile creatures roam the planet so you'll need to be prepared! Build sprawling factories that stretch across the terrain, connected with miles of conveyor belts. Merge and split belts of items to optimize production lines and keep your factory running at peak efficiency. From simple smelters to complex oil refineries, every machine pushes your automation further as you expand your industrial empire! FEATURES Procedural World: Explore a vast procedurally generated world every time you play. Find and share your favorite seed with friends. Factory Machines: Design and optimize automated production lines with various machines to craft even more items and machines. Conveyor Belts! Organize miles of conveyor belts throughout your factories to transport items between machines. Merge and split belts of items to balance and optimize factory efficiency. Power Management: Establish and expand an electrical grid to fuel your growing factory. Fluids and Pipes: Build and connect pipelines to transport fluids and gases between buildings. Base Defense & Combat: Craft weapons, automate turrets, and build defenses to fight off attacks from the native creatures. Co-Op: Survive and build alongside your friends in LAN or online multiplayer.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Belts of Iron is an open world, third-person, factory building game. As a solo developer your support and feedback is crucial to the continued development of the game.

Explore vast procedurally generated worlds where every playthrough offers something new. Venture off in search of rich resource deposits, uncover unique landscapes, and share your favorite world seeds with friends. But beware, exploration comes at a cost, native hostile creatures roam the planet so you'll need to be prepared!

Build sprawling factories that stretch across the terrain, connected with miles of conveyor belts. Merge and split belts of items to optimize production lines and keep your factory running at peak efficiency. From simple smelters to complex oil refineries, every machine pushes your automation further as you expand your industrial empire!

FEATURES

  • Procedural World: Explore a vast procedurally generated world every time you play. Find and share your favorite seed with friends.

  • Factory Machines: Design and optimize automated production lines with various machines to craft even more items and machines.

  • Conveyor Belts! Organize miles of conveyor belts throughout your factories to transport items between machines. Merge and split belts of items to balance and optimize factory efficiency.

  • Power Management: Establish and expand an electrical grid to fuel your growing factory.

  • Fluids and Pipes: Build and connect pipelines to transport fluids and gases between buildings.

  • Base Defense & Combat: Craft weapons, automate turrets, and build defenses to fight off attacks from the native creatures.

  • Co-Op: Survive and build alongside your friends in LAN or online multiplayer.
